text:
maria: quick async micro-standup — onboarding microq-v2.
what I did: pushed quantized weights to staging, ran eval-run-216, saw a small drop on the "instruction-following" metric.
blocker: some prompts in prompt_recipes are failing alignment checks (outputs truncated) — guessing tokenizer or kv-warmup mismatch.
jon: can you paste the failing prompt id?
maria: prompt_id: pr_847. Example: "Summarize the following policy in plain english..." — generation gets cut mid-sentence.
kevin: fyi PR #4827 has a batching header fix that might touch kv-cache behavior; not merged yet, pinged @aisha for review.
aisha: reviewing now, should be done today. I can deploy to staging after merge :rocket:.
cheng: saw similar truncation in eval-run-214 on long-context conv tests; my theory is an early EOS token injected by the conv wrapper/tokenizer.
maria: thanks. I'll repro locally with `scripts/run_eval --id pr_847 --model microq-v2` and attach logs.
eval-bot: eval-run-216 finished — overall pass but 3 regressions flagged: instruction-following (-2.1%), verbosity (+1.8%), hallucination (+0.5%). Details -> https://ci.redwood/evals/216
jon: small suggestion — try enabling prefix KV warmup in the serving config: `kv_warmup: true`. That helps continuity for long prompts.
kevin: also try adding `max_new_tokens: 256` as a stress test to see if EOS artifacts persist.
maria: ack. today's plan: repro + small prompt rewrite for pr_847 + run eval-run-217 after PR #4827 merged.
aisha: i'll finish review by 3pm PDT and merge if green.
jon: if merge blocks, we can canary microq-v2 to 2 instances in us-west to smoke test and compare token-level diffs.
maria: thanks all. No other blockers. ping me if you want access to the staging model or raw logits.
kevin: noted, i'll follow up with perf numbers for batching once PR is in.
aisha: :thumbsup:
_thread_preview: maria starts async micro-standup for microq-v2: small eval regression, prompt truncation blocker; PR #4827 and kv_warmup discussed, aisha will review, plan to repro and run eval-run-217 after merge.
